brief: A personal note-taking browser extension. It should feel calm and private, with a little playfulness.
criteria: Recognisable at 16 px in the toolbar, works in one colour, feels friendly rather than corporate.

concepts.name: Keepsake
concepts.idea: A soft keepsake jar whose lid seam and slot make a quiet smile.
rationale: A lid you can close: your notes stay private
The smile keeps it friendly, never corporate
Soft squircle form, simplified cut for 16 px

recommendation: Keepsake in deep teal: calm, private and a little playful.
next_steps: Swap the extension icon to the new mark
